title: A shelf with personality
objective: Turn the homepage's collectible presentation into a concrete reason to explore more than one fragrance.
casting: One adult Filipino woman's hand arranging the two white-label women's products. No face or body above forearm level.
description: Build a scent collection that looks as good on your shelf as it feels in your routine.
scene: A cherry-red shelf against a warm ochre wall. Mojito Metallique and Amber Oud Silk stand in front of their exact yellow and peach canisters. A cream scalloped dish at the edge provides a lived-in apartment styling cue.
styling: Coral nails, one simple gold ring, peach or cream cuff. Keep the bottles and their canisters the dominant shapes.
props: Two exact bottles, two matching closed canisters, red shelf, cream dish. Do not add other perfume varieties, prices or bundle graphics.
lighting: Hard side sun with a soft fill at label height. Retain separate yellow and peach colors, with enough contrast between peach canister and warm wall.
camera: Shoot straight toward the shelf from slightly above bottle height. Keep both labels sharp; use a slow short slider move only after the locked master take.
performance: Move one bottle a few centimeters into its final position, withdraw the hand, then introduce the second. Each bottle should stay safely on the shelf; avoid clinking glass together.
sound: Licensed bright instrumental, a gentle canister set-down and subtle glass contact with a padded shelf surface. Keep voiceover clear.
